questions.knowledge_point: 动作词汇 jump / run / swim / fly
questions.question: 「它会飞。」的英文是（　）

knowledge.point: 动作词汇 jump / run / swim / fly
knowledge.core_concept: jump 跳、run 跑、swim 游泳、fly 飞；jump far 跳得远、run fast 跑得快。
knowledge.key_formula: I can jump far. / It can fly.
knowledge.tips: far 管距离，fast 管速度。
